newsitem.title: USA: DuPont still looking at Conoco options.
newsitem.headline: DuPont still looking at Conoco options.

text.p: DuPont Co may consider joint ventures or even the sale of the downstream operations of its Conoco petroleum unit if the business could not eventually return cost of capital plus 12 percent, a senior company official said on Wednesday.

"Hopefully the answer will be fixing the business, but we are always open to a wide variety of strategic options," Chief Financial Officer Kurt Landgraf said during a conference call after the company released its first-quarter earnings.
Landgraf said Conoco's upstream operations made significantly more than the 12 percent benchmark.
Asked whether DuPont was ready to make an acquisition, Landgraf said the company had a very strong balance sheet and was examining possibilities.
Analysts say that DuPont had $10 billion in buying power and could generate another $10 billion with the sale of Conoco. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
